thread:
maria-partners: Kicking off the Orbis early preview — telemetry + perf benching focus. NDA in flight, but want to align on test matrix and handoff timeline. Docs: https://redwood-internal/partnerships/orbis-preview (wip)

orbis-ops: Thanks Maria — NDA sent to our legal yesterday. Expect signed by EOD Thu from Orbis side. Confirming they'll provide two SKUs: O-64 and O-128.

jake-hw: O-128 has 80GB HBM, we should test 8/16x batch modes and KV cache behavior. Will need our custom kernel build for the board.

lee-bench: Drafted initial bench plan, aiming for latency p50/p99, tokens/sec, and memory wall-clock. Also include end-to-end prompt regression on our 12-core eval set.

anya-legal: @orbis-ops once signed please drop the executed PDF here. Note: add telemetry whitelist clause (only aggregate infra metrics, no customer payload).

sam-se: Copy — SEs need a stable image + startup instructions. Can Orbis provide ssh access to a test host for our engineers?

orbis-ops: Yes, we'll provision a sandbox cluster with VPN creds. ETA Mon. We'll also share a recovery image and a serial console endpoint.

olivia-pm: Key deadlines: NDA by Thu, infra access Mon, bench window Mon-Fri next week. Can we ship runbook and dataset by EOD Fri?

maria-partners: I'll own the runbook draft. @tim-eng can you prepare the kernel/packaging checklist?

tim-eng: On it. I'll push a build doc to the repo and add a small script to mount the NVMe images. Expect PR by tomorrow afternoon.

lee-bench: Proposed test matrix (short):
models: r-instruct-1-small, r-chat-1, r-embed-1; seq lengths: 512, 1024, 2048; batch sizes: 1, 4, 8, 16; profiles: latency-slo, throughput-burst; metrics: p50/p95/p99, TTFB, tokens/sec, GPU mem usage, temp throttling.

lee-bench: Also want to run a warm-cache vs cold-cache comparison (KV caching + prefix hotpath).

jake-hw: For O-64 we'll limit to batch <=8 and seq<=1024 to stay within thermal headroom. We'll provide power-pcap numbers during tests.

sam-se: Note for SEs: include instructions for enabling remote logging (rsyslog -> s3) and our telemetry agent. @anya-legal we'll need a short consent blurb for logs.

anya-legal: Drafted: "Redwood will collect aggregate performance and host-level telemetry for the purposes of system tuning and benchmarking. No user payload or PII will be collected." Will attach to NDA package.

maria-partners: Ops checklist (high level): NDA signed (Orbis); Sandbox access provisioned; Kernel/image packaging PR merged; Runbook + bench dataset shared; Bench run (Mon-Fri) + daily sync at 10am; Postmortem + feedback doc by following Tue.

orbis-ops: Agreed. We can do 10am sync. Slack channel invite for Orbis engs coming now.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: kernel-build-2026-03-25 to sandbox at 02:00 UTC.

olivia-pm: Quick gating Q: do we need a smaller smoke run first (Sanity) before full matrix? Suggest Wed morning smoke on both SKUs.

lee-bench: Yes, smoke run Wed AM. If green, full matrix Wed afternoon -> Fri. I'll script smoke -> publish pass/fail summary to the doc.

jake-hw: I'll be oncall for thermal anomalies during the run. If temp > 85C for sustained 2 min we throttle and abort that test.

sam-se: SEs will take notes on any perf deltas vs our cloud baseline (gcp/tpu). Want short table in the feedback doc: delta p99, delta cost/token, notable regressions.

maria-partners: Perfect. Action items: @anya-legal add NDA PDF; @tim-eng kernel PR; @lee-bench smoke script; @orbis-ops sandbox creds. We'll meet 10am Mon for handoff.

orbis-ops: Uploading creds to the secure share now. Ping if anything missing.

maria-partners: Thanks all :raised_hands: — I'll post the calendar invite for the daily 10am sync and link the runbook once created.
